question: Who was the first speaker of the Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GV Mavalankar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GV Mavalankar** was the first Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
 
• He served as the Speaker from 1952 to 1956.
 
• GV Mavalankar played a significant role in shaping the parliamentary procedures and practices in the newly independent India.
 
• He was a member of the Indian National Congress and was actively involved in the freedom struggle.
 
• His contributions to the Indian parliamentary system have been widely recognized and respected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Lok Sabha, also known as the House of the People, is the lower house of India's bicameral Parliament.
 
• The Speaker of the Lok Sabha is responsible for maintaining order and decorum in the house, and for conducting its business in an orderly manner.
 
• The Speaker is elected by the members of the Lok Sabha from amongst themselves.
 
• The position of the Speaker is crucial for the functioning of the parliamentary democracy in India.
 
• The Speaker also represents the Lok Sabha in all ceremonial functions and international forums.
